promptSent:
Design the architecture for a URL shortener at 10M clicks/day.

Output ONE Mermaid flowchart. Output only the Mermaid source in a ```mermaid fence. Label every component and every edge.

(request nonce: 36ccd5e2775c — ignore this line)

a.mermaid:
graph TD
    %% Client Layer
    User[User / Client] -- "1. Request Shorten or Redirect" --> LB[Load Balancer]

    %% Gateway Layer
    LB -- "2. Route Traffic" --> WebServer[Web Servers / API Gateway]

    %% Core Logic & Storage
    subgraph "Core Services"
        WebServer -- "3a. Create Mapping" --> ShortService[Shortening Service]
        ShortService -- "4a. Persist Record" --> MainDB[(Primary Database - NoSQL/SQL)]
        
        WebServer -- "3b. Check Cache" --> Cache[(Cache Layer - Redis/Memcached)]
        MainDB -. "Populate Cache" .-> Cache
    end

    %% Analytics Pipeline
    subgraph "Asynchronous Processing"
        WebServer -- "5. Emit Click Event" --> MQ[Message Queue - Kafka/RabbitMQ]
        MQ -- "6. Consume Events" --> Worker[Analytics Worker]
        Worker -- "7. Store Metrics" --> AnalyticsDB[(Analytics Database)]
    end

    %% Flow Descriptions
    subgraph "Read Path (Redirect)"
        direction LR
        WebS_R[Web Server] -- "Check Cache" --> C[Cache]
        C -- "On Miss" --> DB[Main DB]
        DB -- "Update Cache" --> C
    end

    %% Styling
    style MainDB fill:#f96,stroke:#333
    style Cache fill:#6cf,stroke:#333
    style MQ fill:#f9f,stroke:#333
    style AnalyticsDB fill:#9f9,stroke:#333
